caveats: Fit is poor: the asymptote hit its 0 bound and the fit at 1x (error 0.0628) is above the observed 0.0590; the late rise follows the learning-rate schedule, not just more data.
The fresh-site weakness (flat ground) is a training-data gap; more epochs on the same 8 sites are not expected to fix it, so the fresh projection is the least trustworthy.

out_of_sample_check.what: The checkpoint was in fact trained on to 6,000 steps (1.84x) in addendum 4, at a near-zero learning rate.
out_of_sample_check.reading: Measured 1.84x validation (0.3734) sits at the top of the 2x band: the curve-fit gain did not materialise with the resumed (wrong) schedule; an uninterrupted 6,000-step run was never done.

targets.target: Pass the Site11 gate (lose no mission classic or the current pilot lands, more total landings) and then beat classic on NEW unseen maps under harsh rates with exact McNemar p < 0.05; first sub-goal: engine-out success >= classic (98.4% vs pilot 95.9% on the unseen maps).
targets.why_no_projection: The validation curve is not monotone: Site11 success 0.945 -> 0.969 (update 40) -> 0.898 (update 60) -> 0.945 (update 110) on only 128 missions (1 mission = 0.8 pts); no saturating trend to fit. The gate job's training rounds had 4-5 updates each.
